summary: Clamps text to a number of lines and, only when the text actually overflows, shows a “Mostra di più / Mostra meno” (Show more / Show less) button to reveal the full content.
whenToUse: Long descriptions in cards and lists; notes and comments.
whenNotToUse: Critical information or instructions: show them in full.

props.name: lines
props.description: Visible lines; 1 uses a single-line ellipsis.

props.name: hideToggle
props.description: Hides the button (only if the full text is available elsewhere).

inherits: HTML attributes of <div>; ref to the container.
accessibility: The button is a real <button> with aria-expanded and aria-controls: no functionality is available only on hover.
Truncated text stays in the DOM: screen readers still read the full content.
commonMistakes: Truncating titles needed to tell similar items apart.

examples.name: Controlled
examples.title: Controlled expansion
examples.description: Each review's expanded state lives in the example; an external button expands or collapses them all. The second one is in English.

examples.name: ShortAndNoToggle
examples.title: Short text and hideToggle
examples.description: Without overflow the button does not appear; with hideToggle the text stays truncated.
